what_this_is: Receipt for data/v4/corpus-v4-r2.jsonl (ledger item C-5): the refusal stream reweighted to the policy target.

policy.target_share_basis: v2 arm B's measured refusal share — the lowest share for which the programme has a measured FRR and a measured harmful-compliance count on the same instrument
policy.decision: W-3, a programme decision approved on 2026-10-23, with its reversal path recorded in the programme's decision log
policy.note: the programme record also calls the target weight an open decision (NEXT-STEPS.md §2); the target is therefore one parameter away from being changed, and the alternatives' row counts are computed below.

solved.why_the_denominator_matters: D5's removal shrank the corpus from 140,545 to 112,508 rows while the refusal stream stayed at 9,584 presentations, so the refusal share ROSE from 6.82 % to 8.52 %. A share is a ratio, so the reweight is solved against the FINAL denominator.

selection_rule: every distinct refusal row is kept at least once; the remaining presentations are spread evenly over the distinct rows in a deterministic round-robin, so no refusal family is over-represented

controlled_pair.arms: v2 arm A vs v2 arm B (identical mixtures, one stream swapped)
controlled_pair.reading: the false-refusal movement is certain and large; the harmful-side movement on the same pair is not statistically significant
controlled_pair.caveat: one swapped stream is not one changed property — inside the substituted rows the content type, the prompt diversity and the answer length all move together (docs/DISPOSITIONS.md §B-7 and EVALUATION.md §5.3.9)

expected_at_this_target.frr_basis: MEASURED — arm B's rate at this share
expected_at_this_target.programme_release_bar: at most 1/159 harmful, two-sided 95 % Wilson upper at most 3.5 % — the public comparator fails this bar too (3/159, upper 0.0540), so the bar as written excludes the market comparator. This is an open programme decision, not one this policy can settle.
expected_at_this_target.base_model_floor: the untrained base model is at 4.13 % FRR with 1/159 — no corpus reweighting can reach the comparator's 1.07 %
